meta.title: Grant County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Grant County's 2026 annual budget as filed with the state. Amounts are the projected expenses the quorum court adopted for each office and fund. The county also moves money between its own funds: $2,098,444.47 of transfers out are budgeted, so those dollars appear in both the fund that sends them and the fund that receives them.

nodes.name: Circuit Court Automation Fund
nodes.note: The budget page prints this fund as one line with no category total.

nodes.name: Museum Special Fund
nodes.note: Printed as four expense lines with a total; no category totals.
